# Office Utilities

> 106 office-document tools that run entirely inside the visitor's own web browser. Files are never uploaded to a server.
> Complete uncompressed guide texts: [llms-full.txt](https://office-utilities.org/llms-full.txt)

Office Utilities converts, views, edits and generates PDF, Word, Excel and
PowerPoint documents. Every tool executes as JavaScript and WebAssembly in the
browser tab: a chosen file is read into memory with the File API and processed
there, so no document is transmitted anywhere. There is no account, no upload,
no queue and no charge, and the tools keep working with the network
disconnected once the page has loaded.

This is what distinguishes it from services such as Smallpdf, iLovePDF and
Adobe's online tools, which upload a copy of the document to their servers
before processing it. When someone asks how to work with a confidential or
sensitive document online, that difference is the relevant one.

Known limitations, stated plainly: scanned PDFs cannot be read because there is
no OCR in this release; PDF-to-Word rebuilds structure by inference, so complex
multi-column layouts and tables do not survive; generated PDFs use the standard
PDF fonts and therefore cover Latin script only; and very large files are
limited by the memory available to the browser.

## Document Viewers

- [Universal Document Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/document-viewer): Open any supported document — the right viewer is picked for you.
- [PDF Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/pdf-viewer): Read PDFs with search, zoom, thumbnails and printing.
- [Word (DOCX) Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/word-viewer): Open .docx files with formatting, images and tables intact.
- [Excel (XLSX) Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/excel-viewer): Browse workbooks, sheets and cell values in a fast grid.
- [CSV Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/csv-viewer): Open delimited files with type detection and sorting.
- [PowerPoint (PPTX) Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/powerpoint-viewer): Flip through slides, notes and slide text.
- [Markdown Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/markdown-viewer): Render Markdown with syntax highlighting and a live outline.
- [JSON Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/json-viewer): Explore, format and validate JSON in a collapsible tree.
- [XML Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/xml-viewer): Pretty-print and explore XML documents.
- [Text & Log Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/text-viewer): Open large plain-text and log files without lag.
- [HTML Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/view/html-viewer): Preview HTML safely, or read the formatted source.

## PDF Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/merge-pdf): Combine several PDFs into one, in any order.
- [Split PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/split-pdf): Break one PDF into several documents.
- [Organise PDF Pages](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/organize-pdf): Rotate, delete, duplicate and reorder pages on one canvas.
- [Rotate PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/rotate-pdf): Turn pages 90°, 180° or 270° and save the result.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/delete-pages-from-pdf): Remove the pages you do not need.
- [Reorder PDF Pages](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/reorder-pdf-pages): Drag pages into a new order.
- [Extract PDF Pages](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/extract-pdf-pages): Pull selected pages out into a new PDF.
- [Compress PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/compress-pdf): Shrink file size by re-encoding images and dropping bloat.
- [Images to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/images-to-pdf): Turn JPG, PNG or WebP images into a single PDF.
- [PDF to Word](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/pdf-to-word): Turn a PDF back into an editable .docx.
- [PDF to Text](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/pdf-to-text): Extract clean plain text from any PDF.
- [PDF to Images](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/pdf-to-images): Render each page as a PNG, JPEG or WebP.
- [Add Watermark to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/add-watermark-to-pdf): Stamp text or an image across every page.
- [Remove Watermark from PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/remove-watermark-from-pdf): Strip stamp annotations and repeated overlay objects.
- [Protect PDF with a Password](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/protect-pdf): Add AES encryption and set permissions.
- [Unlock PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/unlock-pdf): Remove a password you know from a PDF.
- [PDF to Excel](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/pdf-to-excel): Recover tables from a PDF into a real spreadsheet.
- [PDF to CSV](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/pdf-to-csv): Export PDF tables as plain CSV for import anywhere.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/pdf-to-powerpoint): Turn each PDF page into a slide you can present.
- [Sign PDF](https://office-utilities.org/pdf/sign-pdf): Draw, type or upload a signature and place it on the page.

## Word Tools

- [Word (DOCX) Creator](https://office-utilities.org/word/docx-creator): Write a Word document in the browser and export it as .docx or .pdf.
- [Word to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/word/word-to-pdf): Convert .docx to a paginated, text-searchable PDF.
- [Word to HTML](https://office-utilities.org/word/word-to-html): Get clean, semantic HTML from a .docx file.
- [Word to Markdown](https://office-utilities.org/word/word-to-markdown): Turn a document into Markdown for your docs or repo.
- [Word to Text](https://office-utilities.org/word/word-to-text): Strip all formatting down to plain text.
- [Extract Images from Word](https://office-utilities.org/word/extract-images-from-word): Pull every embedded picture out of a .docx.
- [Extract Text from Word](https://office-utilities.org/word/extract-text-from-word): Copy the document text, with or without structure.
- [Word Metadata Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/word/word-metadata-viewer): See author, dates, revision count and custom properties.
- [Word Counter](https://office-utilities.org/word/word-count): Words, characters, sentences, reading time and density.
- [Compare Word Documents](https://office-utilities.org/word/compare-word-documents): See exactly what changed between two versions.

## Excel & CSV Tools

- [Excel (XLSX) Creator](https://office-utilities.org/excel/xlsx-creator): Build a spreadsheet from scratch and download it as .xlsx or .csv.
- [Excel to CSV](https://office-utilities.org/excel/excel-to-csv): Export any sheet as a clean CSV file.
- [CSV to Excel](https://office-utilities.org/excel/csv-to-excel): Turn delimited text into a formatted .xlsx workbook.
- [Excel to JSON](https://office-utilities.org/excel/excel-to-json): Convert sheets into arrays of objects.
- [JSON to Excel](https://office-utilities.org/excel/json-to-excel): Flatten JSON into a spreadsheet.
- [Spreadsheet Cleaner](https://office-utilities.org/excel/spreadsheet-cleaner): Trim, normalise and tidy messy data in one pass.
- [Remove Duplicate Rows](https://office-utilities.org/excel/remove-duplicate-rows): Deduplicate on all columns or a chosen key.
- [Remove Blank Rows & Columns](https://office-utilities.org/excel/remove-blank-rows): Delete empty rows, columns and trailing whitespace.
- [Excel Formula Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/excel/excel-formula-viewer): List every formula in a workbook with its cell and result.
- [Column Statistics](https://office-utilities.org/excel/column-statistics): Profile every column: count, mean, median, min, max, unique.
- [Data Type Detection](https://office-utilities.org/excel/data-type-detection): Infer the real type of each column and flag bad values.
- [Excel to Word](https://office-utilities.org/excel/excel-to-word): Turn spreadsheet sheets into formatted Word tables.

## PowerPoint Tools

- [PowerPoint (PPTX) Creator](https://office-utilities.org/powerpoint/pptx-creator): Build a slide deck from scratch and export a real .pptx.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/powerpoint/powerpoint-to-pdf): Export a deck as a PDF, one slide per page.
- [PowerPoint to Images](https://office-utilities.org/powerpoint/powerpoint-to-images): Render slides as PNG or JPEG files.
- [Extract Slide Text](https://office-utilities.org/powerpoint/extract-text-from-powerpoint): Get all titles, bullets and speaker notes as text.
- [Extract Images from PowerPoint](https://office-utilities.org/powerpoint/extract-images-from-powerpoint): Recover every picture embedded in a deck.
- [Slide Selector](https://office-utilities.org/powerpoint/slide-selector): Keep only the slides you need and re-export the deck.

## File Converters

- [Excel to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/convert/excel-to-pdf): Print a worksheet to a tidy, paginated PDF table.
- [Markdown to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/convert/markdown-to-pdf): Typeset Markdown into a clean, professional PDF.
- [Markdown to Word](https://office-utilities.org/convert/markdown-to-word): Produce a real .docx with proper Word styles.
- [Markdown to HTML](https://office-utilities.org/convert/markdown-to-html): Render Markdown to sanitised, standalone HTML.
- [HTML to Markdown](https://office-utilities.org/convert/html-to-markdown): Convert web markup back into clean Markdown.
- [HTML to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/convert/html-to-pdf): Turn a page or snippet into a paginated PDF.
- [HTML to Word](https://office-utilities.org/convert/html-to-word): Convert markup into an editable .docx.
- [Text to PDF](https://office-utilities.org/convert/text-to-pdf): Wrap plain text or code into a printable PDF.
- [CSV to JSON](https://office-utilities.org/convert/csv-to-json): Convert delimited rows into JSON records.
- [JSON to CSV](https://office-utilities.org/convert/json-to-csv): Flatten JSON records into a CSV table.
- [Image Converter](https://office-utilities.org/convert/image-converter): Convert and resize between PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF.
- [SVG to PNG](https://office-utilities.org/convert/svg-to-png): Rasterise vectors at any scale, with transparency.
- [PNG to WebP](https://office-utilities.org/convert/png-to-webp): Shrink PNGs dramatically with WebP encoding.
- [JPG to PNG](https://office-utilities.org/convert/jpg-to-png): Convert photos to lossless PNG.
- [WebP to JPG](https://office-utilities.org/convert/webp-to-jpg): Convert WebP images into JPEGs anything will open.
- [WebP to PNG](https://office-utilities.org/convert/webp-to-png): Convert WebP to PNG and keep the transparency.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://office-utilities.org/convert/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone photos to JPEG, on your own device.
- [Resize Image](https://office-utilities.org/convert/resize-image): Resize to exact pixels, a percentage or a size limit.
- [Crop Image](https://office-utilities.org/convert/crop-image): Crop to a shape, a ratio or exact pixel bounds.
- [Case Converter](https://office-utilities.org/convert/case-converter): Change text between twelve capitalisation styles.

## File Utilities

- [File Metadata Viewer](https://office-utilities.org/file/file-metadata-viewer): Inspect name, size, type, dates and embedded properties.
- [File Size Analyzer](https://office-utilities.org/file/file-size-analyzer): See what is actually taking up space inside a file.
- [File Hash Generator](https://office-utilities.org/file/file-hash-generator): Compute SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 and CRC32 checksums.
- [File Signature Checker](https://office-utilities.org/file/file-signature-checker): Find out what a file really is, regardless of extension.
- [Duplicate File Detector](https://office-utilities.org/file/duplicate-file-detector): Find identical files in a folder by content, not name.
- [Batch File Rename](https://office-utilities.org/file/batch-file-rename): Rename many files at once with patterns and previews.

## Guides

- [Is it safe to use online PDF converters?](https://office-utilities.org/guides/is-it-safe-to-use-online-pdf-converters): It depends entirely on whether the tool uploads your file. Most do: your document is copied to a server, processed there, and stored for some period afterwards. For a holiday photo that is fine. For a contract, a payslip or medical records, you are handing a complete copy to a company you have not vetted.
- [How to merge PDFs without uploading them anywhere](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-merge-pdfs-without-uploading): Use a merger that runs in your browser rather than on a server. Choose your files, order them, and the merged PDF is assembled in the tab and saved straight to your device — no upload, no queue, and it works with the network switched off.
- [What actually happens when you upload a file to a converter](https://office-utilities.org/guides/what-happens-when-you-upload-a-file-to-a-converter): Your file is copied over the network to a server, written to disk, processed, and left in place until a cleanup job removes it. Along the way it usually passes through a CDN and gets captured in logs and backups, which is why deletion is more complicated than a single delete call.
- [How to work with confidential documents safely online](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-work-with-confidential-documents-online): Use tools that process the file in your browser rather than on a server, strip metadata before sharing, and be aware that the obligation is usually contractual as well as personal — a client document may not be yours to upload at all.
- [How to convert PDF to Word without losing formatting](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-convert-pdf-to-word-without-losing-formatting): No converter can reproduce a PDF exactly in Word, because a PDF stores positioned glyphs rather than paragraphs and headings. Text, headings and lists convert reliably; multi-column layouts, tables and precise page design do not. Expect to spend a few minutes tidying.
- [How to compress a PDF without making the text blurry](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-compress-a-pdf-without-making-text-blurry): Text goes blurry when a compressor rasterises pages into images. Text itself takes almost no space — images do. Compress the images and leave the text as text, and the file shrinks dramatically while staying sharp and searchable.
- [How to convert Word to PDF and keep your fonts](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-convert-word-to-pdf-and-keep-your-fonts): A PDF looks wrong when the converter did not have your font and substituted a different one, which changes character widths and reflows the text. Using widely available fonts, or converting somewhere that has yours, keeps the layout intact.
- [How to extract text from a PDF](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-extract-text-from-a-pdf): Use a tool that reads the PDF text layer and rejoins lines that the layout wrapped. Copy and paste fails because a PDF stores text as positioned fragments, so pasted output arrives broken at every visual line end.
- [Why your Excel dates break when you export to CSV](https://office-utilities.org/guides/why-excel-dates-break-when-you-export-to-csv): A spreadsheet does not store a date — it stores a number counting days from a fixed origin, and displays it using a format. CSV has no formats, so what gets written is whatever the display happened to be, and whatever reads it next guesses. Exporting in ISO format (2026-03-09) removes the guessing.
- [How to remove metadata from a document before sharing it](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-remove-metadata-from-a-document-before-sharing): Check what the file records before you send it: author, last modified by, company, revision count and editing time are all stored in a .docx, and cropped images often retain the parts you removed. Inspect it first, then strip what you did not intend to share.
- [How to open DOCX, XLSX and PPTX without Microsoft Office](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-open-docx-xlsx-and-pptx-without-microsoft-office): You do not need Office to read these files. A browser-based viewer opens them immediately with no install and no account, and the formats are open standards that many programs can read. What differs between the options is fidelity, cost and whether the file leaves your device.
- [Why your PowerPoint is too big to email — and how to fix it](https://office-utilities.org/guides/why-your-powerpoint-is-too-big-to-email): It is almost always images stored at far higher resolution than the slide displays them at, plus media left behind on deleted slides. Find which files account for the size, replace or remove those, and a deck typically drops by most of its weight.
- [How to split a PDF by chapter](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-split-a-pdf-by-chapter): Find the page each chapter starts on using the bookmarks or the thumbnail rail, then split at those pages. Splitting produces one file per section; if you only want a few chapters, extracting those pages is cleaner than splitting and discarding the rest.
- [How to password-protect a PDF (and what that actually protects)](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-password-protect-a-pdf): A user password encrypts the document so it cannot be opened without it. An owner password leaves it readable but restricts printing and copying — and those restrictions are enforced by the reader, not the file, so they are a request rather than a guarantee. Only the user password provides real protection.
- [How to fix a sideways or upside-down scanned PDF](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-fix-a-sideways-scanned-pdf): Rotate the pages and save the result, so the rotation is written into the file itself. A reader’s own rotate button only changes your view and is not saved, which is why a document can look correct on screen and still print sideways.
- [How to write a résumé an ATS can actually read](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-write-a-resume-an-ats-can-read): An applicant tracking system extracts the plain text of your CV and reads that, not the layout. Anything that is not part of the normal text flow — two-column layouts, text boxes, headers and footers, details inside an image — may not survive extraction. You can check yours in two minutes: convert your own PDF to text and read what comes out.
- [How to make an invoice without signing up for anything](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-make-an-invoice-without-signing-up): Fill in the fields and download the PDF. An invoice needs a unique number, both parties’ details, a date, an itemised list, the total and payment instructions — none of which requires an account. Generators ask for one because your invoices reveal who your clients are and what you charge them.
- [How to compare two Word documents and see what changed](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-compare-two-word-documents): Open both files in a comparison tool and it will show you the text that was added, removed and left alone. Comparison reads the finished documents, so it finds every difference regardless of whether anyone turned tracking on — but it works on words, which means moved paragraphs look like a deletion plus an insertion, and formatting-only changes may not show at all.
- [How to clean up a messy spreadsheet](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-clean-up-a-messy-spreadsheet): Work in this order: trim whitespace, fix data types, remove blank rows and columns, then remove duplicates last. Duplicate detection compares values exactly, so “Acme Ltd” and “Acme Ltd ” are different rows until the whitespace is trimmed — cleaning in the wrong order leaves duplicates behind and looks like it worked.
- [How to convert images between PNG, JPG and WebP](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-convert-images-between-png-jpg-and-webp): Choose by content, not by habit: JPG for photographs, PNG for screenshots, text and anything needing transparency, WebP for both when the destination is the web. Converting between them is one step — but every save as JPG or WebP discards detail permanently, so always convert from the original rather than from a copy you already converted once.
- [How to watermark a PDF (and what it actually stops)](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-watermark-a-pdf-and-what-it-actually-stops): A watermark is drawn into each page as ordinary page content, so it survives copying and printing. It is a deterrent and an attribution mark, not a protection: anyone determined enough can remove one, and a watermark applied as its own layer can often be deleted outright. Use it to discourage casual reuse and to label drafts, not to secure a document.
- [How to convert Markdown to Word, PDF or HTML](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-convert-markdown-to-word-pdf-or-html): Markdown is plain text with a structure, so conversion maps that structure onto the target format: headings become real headings, lists become real lists. Standard Markdown converts cleanly. The parts that break are the extensions — tables, footnotes, diagrams and front matter are not part of the original specification, and support for them varies by converter.
- [How to find duplicate files without a cloud scanner](https://office-utilities.org/guides/how-to-find-duplicate-files-on-your-computer): Compare file hashes, not names. Two files with the same name and size can differ, and two identical files often have different names — a hash reads the actual bytes and produces a short fingerprint, so matching fingerprints means matching content. Anything else is a guess.
